name: Villegas (Spain)
description: Square flag of three horizontal stripes of green, red and blue, the red fimbriated yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villegas (ears of wheat, a crozier, a mountain and a tower).
history: Municipal flag of Villegas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villegas arms — ears of wheat, crozier, mountain and tower
